title: Returning a Carry-Out Battery: Conditions of Refund under the Battery Replacement Warranties
content:
Only a carry-out battery can be returned for a refund; a battery Crestline installed is never returned outside a warranty claim. These conditions apply to every line of the Battery Replacement Warranties.

**1. Which battery.** The battery must have been sold as carry-out and still be active when it is returned. Both are read from Crestline's record of that battery's warranty.

**2. Whose decision.** The return is the customer's own decision and is confirmed by the customer.

**3. When.** The return must be completed within the line's carry-out return period of the purchase date, counted in calendar days from the day after the purchase date.

**4. Condition.** The battery must be unused and fully charged, as checked by a test at the store.

**5. Refund.** The refund is the purchase price less the line's restocking fee percentage of that price, the refund amount rounded half up to the cent, paid to the original tender. A refund to the Crestline Credit Card posts to the card account as a merchandise credit; a refund to a Crestline Fleet Account posts as a fleet credit memo.

**6. The warranty.** A returned battery's warranty closes as returned on the return date.

**7. Core deposit.** Any core deposit still held is settled separately under the core deposit rules; it is not part of the refund in condition 5.

## Return period counted (hypothetical dates and a hypothetical 20-day period)

For a purchase dated 5 June, day one is 6 June and day twenty is 25 June. A return completed on 25 June is within the period; a return on 26 June is not.

## Refund figured (hypothetical figures, not any line's)

| Purchase price | Restocking fee | Fee amount | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 0% | 0.00 | 200.00 |
| 200.00 | 15% | 30.00 | 170.00 |
| 187.30 | 15% | 28.095 | 159.205, rounded half up to 159.21 |

## Conditions together

| Sold as carry-out | Warranty active | Within the return period | Unused and fully charged on the store test | Refundable on the customer's own confirmed decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| No (installed) | any | any | any | No |
| Yes | No | any | any | No |
| Yes | Yes | No | any | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
